headerButtons: All direct file IO outside the store is in src/cli.ts. Every command (add, list, remove, search, tags) uses existsSync, readFileSync and writeFileSync from node:fs itself. src/store.ts already has loadStore(path?) and saveStore(store, path?), which do the file IO, plus addBookmark and removeBookmark, which only change the in-memory store. So the refactor is mostly rewiring cli.ts onto the store and dropping its node:fs import. To keep behaviour exactly the same, a few differences need deciding first: add's tag de-duplication, remove's 'no bookmarks file yet' error, and how blank or whitespace-only files are handled.

The only file IO outside the store is in src/cli.ts (node:fs at line 2, used in cmdAdd, cmdList, cmdRemove, cmdSearch and cmdTags). src/store.ts already has loadStore, saveStore, addBookmark and removeBookmark. The refactor rewires cli.ts onto these and adds a storeExists() helper. Two details need care to keep the owner's 'exact behaviour' answers: addBookmark de-duplicates tags through cleanTags, and loadStore keeps only the nextId and bookmarks keys when it normalises a file.

bugs.title: Needs-you dock: an open Director question takes 354-374 px and leaves the chat 200-273 px
bugs.repro: Card with an open grill question (FR-C4, injected open question) at 1600x860, 1280x860, 1024x860 and 390x844; measure the [role=log] scroller. Chat 273/253/200/212 px vs 635/635/582/594 px with nothing waiting.

bugs.title: Dock keyboard stepping dies after clicking Next to the last item: focus drops to <body>
bugs.repro: Card with 3 waiting items, click the dock Next arrow twice: the button disables at 3 of 3 and document.activeElement becomes BODY, so arrows, j/k and 1-4 do nothing until the user tabs back through ~50 stops (sidebar, header, every FR link in the chat).

bugs.title: Disabled dock Next button is labelled "Next waiting item, 4 of 3"
bugs.repro: Step to the last item and read the aria-label of the Next arrow.

bugs.title: Sheet (below 1024 px) does not return focus to its opener on Esc
bugs.repro: 390x844, card FR-C4, focus "Plan and details", Enter, Escape: the sheet closes and the URL returns to /conversation, but focus lands on BODY rather than the opener (the component header says it returns focus).

bugs.title: Director model selects overlap at 768 px
bugs.repro: /settings/director at 768x860: the "Triage" and "Worker prompt" model fields overlap, including their hints and select boxes. At 768 the app sidebar, the settings sub-nav and the content all show side by side, so the content column is about 200 px wide.

bugs.title: Nav ships two unbuilt screens with internal roadmap copy
bugs.repro: Sidebar Issues and Chat open placeholders: "Issues is not built yet ... Coming in W8 of the web build plan", "Chat is not built yet ... Coming in W6 of the web build plan".

bugs.title: Finished work shows stale warnings and waits
bugs.repro: Done ticket FR-6 says "Waiting on FR-5". Cancelled ticket FR-11 says "Waiting on FR-10", "Run ended (success)" and "Gate G1 Failed, round 4". The Done card FR-C4 plan says "Floor check did not pass: changed since the plan was verified". Harnesses says Claude Code is "Not tested yet / Tested not yet" after 50+ runs.

bugs.title: Card event list breaks its bullet layout and floods the chat
bugs.repro: Card chat (any width, worst at 375 and 768): a "Ticket created" event puts the FR-n link alone on a bulleted line, and the text and time wrap below it outside the list. 10-20 "FR-15 moved from X to Y" lines sit between the Director messages.

bugs.title: Board on a phone opens on an empty column
bugs.repro: Board at 375: Shaping (0) fills the first screen with "Nothing here."; the 7 Done cards sit 4 horizontal swipes to the right. Empty columns are full height at every width.

bugs.title: Charts are inaccessible: 90 aria-label on <rect> without a role per chart page
bugs.repro: axe on Overview, Home and Cost: aria-prohibited-attr, 90/90/30 nodes (serious).

bugs.title: Success green and faint text fail contrast
bugs.repro: axe color-contrast, 162 nodes at 1280 across 23 screens: #318f5a on #eaedf1 3.43:1 (run chips), on #fff 4.03:1 (ticket chips), on #f8fafc 3.85:1 (pipeline steps); #94999e placeholders ("All states", "Choose") and the kbd "Ctrl K" 2.87:1. In dark mode only the faint text fails (3.19:1).

bugs.title: Status pill truncates to "D..." at 768
bugs.repro: Card or ticket header at 768: the Done or Cancelled pill is ellipsised because the "Plan and details" button takes the room.

bugs.title: Card and ticket titles cannot be read in full on phones
bugs.repro: At 320-414 the h1 truncates ("Import from...", "Route all CLI file acc..."), with no tooltip or wrap.

bugs.title: Home and Tickets share the same house icon in the sidebar
bugs.repro: Sidebar: Home and Tickets both use a house glyph.

bugs.title: One unreadable waiting item blanks the whole card page
bugs.repro: A needs_you_detail item with an action outside the enum (injected) replaces the whole card with "Forge sent something this version cannot read". The chat and plan are lost, not just the one item.

bugs.title: Limits page shows raw state keys and a free-text harness id
bugs.repro: /settings/limits: "in_progress", "verifying" as labels. "Add a harness cap" wants a typed "Harness id" instead of a picker.

bugs.title: Inbox All and Archived show 0 after a run with many approvals and warnings
bugs.repro: Inbox tabs: Needs action 0, Unread 0, All 0, Archived 0, although the Forge arm acted on tool approvals and budget warnings there. There is no history.

bugs.title: Welcome wizard is still reachable after setup and shows step 1 again
bugs.repro: /welcome on a configured instance shows "Step 1 of 3 Harnesses and logins", "claude Not tested yet", "Forge 0.0.0".

bugs.title: Plan scope columns misalign; reason chips truncate with room to spare
bugs.repro: Plan tab: "Not in scope" items start halfway down, row-aligned with long "In scope" items. Dock reason chip "Plan v2 is ready: 3 tickets, Standa..." truncates even at 1280.
